ezUgyVolt.title: The Story...
ezUgyVolt.paragraph1: We are a handful, but all the more enthusiastic group of young people who thought big and decided to create together what had only been a dream so far: our own festival! This is how the Világomba festival was born. It all started with a shared passion and the desire to create something that brings us and others together for a fantastic summer experience. Because we believe that music, laughter, and being together move energies that we all need.
ezUgyVolt.paragraph2: Although we only brainstormed at first, we quickly realized that our enthusiasm and collaboration can really move mountains - or at least build a festival! During the organization, we all contributed our different talents: some excel in organizing bands, others dreamed up the logistics or the visual world. The most important thing, however, was that we all work for the same goal: to create a festival where everyone can feel at home, and which - we hope - will give us and the visitors memories for years to come.
ezUgyVolt.paragraph3: Sometimes we can barely believe we've made it this far, but the hard work, laughter, and even the harder moments were all worth it. And this is just the beginning! We can't wait to share what we've dreamed up together with you, and to party with you on this crazy, wonderful summer weekend. Thank you to everyone who contributed to making this festival a reality!
ezUgyVolt.closing: See you in Zebegény on August 21, 2026! We are waiting for you!
